requirements.description: Nonces must be 96-bit (12 bytes) and cryptographically random — not counter-based
requirements.finding: Uses os.urandom(12) — 12 bytes from OS CSPRNG, no counter. Compliant.

requirements.description: Key derivation must use PBKDF2 with >= 100,000 iterations
requirements.finding: Uses hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha256', ..., iterations=100000, dklen=32). 100,000 iterations meets the >= 100,000 minimum. Algorithm and key length correct.

requirements.description: GCM authentication tag must be full 16 bytes — no truncation
requirements.finding: encrypt() returns encryptor.tag without truncation. decrypt() uses modes.GCM(nonce, tag) with full tag, no min_tag_length override. Tag is full 16 bytes.

requirements.description: Salt generation using os.urandom() is already correct — do not modify it
requirements.finding: Uses os.urandom(size) — unchanged. Correctly preserved as per spec.

summary: All 4 requirements from spec.md are satisfied. The three cryptographic vulnerabilities (counter-based nonce, weak KDF iterations at 1000, truncated 8-byte GCM tag) have been correctly fixed. Salt generation in utils.py remains unmodified as required.
